# Owned umas

- Server: **Global (English)**. Use Global data. JP-only umas, cards, scenarios and mechanics don't apply until they release on Global.
- Last updated: 2026-10-15, from roster screenshots. Claude matched the icons against uma.guide; names and IDs come from uma.guide (Global).
- Totals: 57 trainees. 12 at 5★, 23 at 4★, 22 at 3★. 42 are at Potential 5.

Stars run 1–5. Potential runs 1–5; each level unlocks more of the uma's own skills. Each outfit is its own row, because a different outfit is a different trainee. ID links open the uma's uma.guide page.
